summary: Verified SEO prerender for the 5 NEW blog posts against preview base URL. 11/11 pytest checks pass: each new /blog/<slug> returns crawler HTML with the correct exact <title>, matching <h1>, Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (+ FAQPage for the two squat-proof posts, including 'light box' body phrase and 'Frequently asked questions' section on how-we-test article); all 8 titles and H1s are unique; /blog index lists all 8 slugs; /sitemap.xml includes all 5 new URLs plus existing; /collections/squat-proof-leggings baked HTML cross-links all 3 squat-proof articles and /collections/high-waisted-gym-leggings cross-links its 3 articles; human UA on a new post still returns the untouched SPA shell.
critical_code_review_comments: seo.py BLOG dict and frontend/src/data/blogPosts.js remain two sources of truth for the same content — the 5 new posts have to be edited in both places. Consider serving blog content from a single JSON (or having the frontend import from a shared module) to prevent drift.
COLLECTION_ARTICLE is now a list-of-articles per collection; ensure the Learn-more loop in Collection.js caps or paginates once a collection accrues >5 articles to avoid layout blow-up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_blog_seo.py (original 3 posts) and /app/backend/tests/test_blog_seo_new_posts.py (5 new posts + collection cross-links + 8-slug uniqueness + sitemap). Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Googlebot UA to trigger craco middleware prerender proxy. Titles HTML-unescaped before matching; expect ''' and '&' in raw HTML for apostrophes/ampersands.
